photography_style.lighting: warm, natural daylight, soft and inviting
photography_style.background: home environment, outdoor park, cozy interior
photography_style.detail_shots: material texture, safety features, size comparison

prompt_templates.hero: Pet brand hero banner for {product_name}. Cute {pet_type} gently interacting with the product in a warm home environment, soft daylight, {visual_style} aesthetic. Product is clearly visible and styled as hero, not just a pet snapshot. Emotional and inviting, professional pet product photography, 8K, no text overlay.
prompt_templates.pain_point: Problem-solution panel for {product_name}. Soft before/after or contrast composition showing the pet issue resolved: anxious vs calm, messy vs tidy, uncomfortable vs cozy. Warm tones, relatable scenario, no actual text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Pet lifestyle panel for {product_name}. Happy {pet_type} using the product in a cozy home setting, natural interaction, warm lighting, candid pet photography, {language} cultural context. Product remains the focal point.
prompt_templates.material: Safety detail panel for {product_name}. Macro close-up of material texture showing softness, durability, and pet-safe quality. Soft lighting, clean background, shallow depth of field. No text.
prompt_templates.core_selling: Pet benefit panel for {product_name}. Product + 2-4 paw-shaped or rounded benefit zones (comfort, safety, easy-clean, vet-approved). Warm playful layout, {visual_style} tones, {language} market. No dense text.
prompt_templates.feature: Feature highlight panel for {product_name}. Close-up of a key feature (closure, padding, anti-slip base, breathable mesh) with soft warm lighting. Professional product photography, no text.
prompt_templates.cta: Final conversion panel for {product_name}. Warm layout: happy pet with product + prominent CTA block + trust micro-badges. {visual_style} tones, no text.

copywriting.cta_style: warm, caring, urgency for pet wellbeing
